# Sidney Nduti

Sidney Nduti is a software engineer and systems architect based in Nairobi, Kenya. He specializes in containerized system integrations, cybersecurity defensive infrastructure, automated API workflow pipelines, and responsive mobile/web applications.

## Technical Skills
- **Core Languages**: Python, Dart (Flutter), JavaScript, Bash, SQL, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Tools & Frameworks**: n8n, Docker, Tailscale, Linux OS administration, Riverpod, Airtable, OpenRouter APIs.
- **Specializations**: Security systems monitoring, network intrusion detection/prevention, automated lead queues, custom cron scripts.

## Core Builds & Case Studies

### 1. Intrusion Detection & Prevention Stack (IDPS)
- **Role**: Systems Security Engineer
- **Category**: Security / Infrastructure
- **Stack**: Suricata, Linux, Docker, Tailscale, Bash
- **Description**: Monitored network port anomalies using signature matching on a containerized Suricata stack. Created self-healing firewall exclusions to ban malicious IPs within 15 seconds, and used Tailscale nodes to lock admin console traffic.
- **Outcome**: 100% of exploits stopped automatically.

### 2. SwiftLead
- **Role**: Automation Specialist
- **Category**: Web Application / Automation
- **Stack**: HTML5, CSS3, JSON-LD, Vite, Async JavaScript
- **Description**: High-performance customer conversion and automation engine designed to eliminate the speed-to-lead response delay by offloading business logic to decoupled async backend pipelines.
- **Outcome**: Lead response and automated acknowledgement latency reduced to < 1 minute.

### 3. IoT-Based Home Automation System
- **Role**: IoT Systems Engineer
- **Category**: Mobile App / Enablement / IoT
- **Stack**: Flutter, Dart, Arduino Uno R3, Bluetooth (HC-05), Firebase, Laravel, Android
- **Description**: Smart home controller system linking a Flutter mobile dashboard to an Arduino hardware board via Bluetooth for local device control, power visualization, fire safety alerting, and Larvel administration.
- **Outcome**: Response latency under 1 second, bringing unified environmental safety and accessibility offline.

### 4. TOPWellness Africa Daily Journal
- **Role**: Mobile App Engineer
- **Category**: Mobile Application
- **Stack**: Flutter, Riverpod, Dart, iOS/Android SDKs
- **Description**: A wellness logging app utilizing Riverpod state providers. Optimizes multi-step slider/badge inputs and presents micro-animated recap charts.
- **Outcome**: +42% daily reflection engagement.

## Production Automations (n8n & AI Orchestration)
See full technical details at: https://sidneynduti.me/automations.html

### 1. SwiftLead — Tier 1 Starter (AI Lead Intake & Smart Routing)
- **Engine**: n8n, OpenRouter (Nemotron 120B), Airtable, Gmail OAuth2
- **Description**: Webhook-triggered pipeline validating inputs, generating atomic sequential IDs, classifying lead intent/urgency with LangChain LLMs, dynamically routing to agents with the least active workload, and firing dual personalized confirmation emails.
- **Outcome**: < 4s end-to-end processing; sub-minute customer acknowledgement.

### 2. SwiftLead — Tier 2 Professional (Slack SLA Watchdog & Escalation Engine)
- **Engine**: n8n, Airtable Poller, Slack Web API
- **Description**: Asynchronous watchdog monitoring response SLA. Sends initial Slack DM to assigned rep with lead details, enforces a 2-hour wait SLA, checks status, triggers an urgent reminder, and escalates to the Sales Manager if untouched after 3 hours.
- **Outcome**: 100% SLA monitoring compliance; zero lead leakage.

### 3. SwiftLead — Tier 3 Premium (Reporting & Dynamic HTML Dashboard)
- **Engine**: n8n, Chart.js, Tailwind CDN, Airtable API
- **Description**: Dual-trigger system delivering daily 24h cron email digests and rendering a self-contained responsive SPA executive dashboard via HTTP webhook with real-time intake velocity charts, AI intent distributions, agent capacity leaderboard, and CSV export.

### 4. DocXpress — Autonomous Accounts Payable & Invoice Processing Pipeline
- **Engine**: n8n, OpenRouter (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning), Airtable, Gmail, Slack
- **Description**: Ingests invoice PDF attachments from email, validates against duplicate submissions in Airtable, extracts 10 structured financial fields via LLMs with strict JSON schemas and confidence scoring, and posts cross-platform receipts.
- **Outcome**: < 15s invoice turnaround time; 95%+ extraction accuracy.

### 5. ThreatPulse — Cyber Threat Intelligence & RSS Feed Syndication (rssfeed)
- **Engine**: n8n, Google Sheets API, RSS Parser, Telegram Bot API
- **Description**: Scheduled cron pipeline scraping authority cybersecurity feeds (The Hacker News, CVE databases), deduplicating articles against a persistent Google Sheets GUID registry, and broadcasting verified zero-day threat advisories to security teams.

### 6. WebHook-Telegram Event Bridge
- **Engine**: n8n, Telegram Bot API
- **Description**: Event-driven webhook listener normalizing arbitrary JSON events and routing formatted alerts into Telegram channels with sub-second latency.
